unlisted_practices: Continuous emergency department safety surveillance with a standardized case review rubric and a centralized REDCap repository
Automated pharmacist consults for high-risk medications (prostacyclin)
Automated aspiration precautions and nothing-by-mouth standing orders for high-risk patients
72-hour return audits and rapid-response activations as safety signals
Same-day specialty pathways, including an outpatient diuresis clinic
Charge nurse reporting and nurse-driven safety rounds

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical implementation and deployment outcomes of a broad emergency department safety surveillance system (SENTRY) that includes an artificial intelligence-based triage tool.
